# 运行前检查

这个模板基于 LTX-Video 2.3 官方 ComfyUI 示例。直接点 Run 前必须满足：

1. 在 LoadImage 节点手动上传参考图。模板中的 upload_reference_image_first.png 只是提示名，不是真实文件。
2. 安装 ComfyUI-LTXVideo 自定义节点。
3. 安装并在节点下拉中选择本机已有的模型文件：
   - ltx-2.3-22b-dev-fp8.safetensors
   - gemma_3_12B_it.safetensors 或你本机实际的 Gemma 文本编码器
   - ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-lora-384-1.1.safetensors 或你本机实际的 LTX 2.3 LoRA

如果节点下拉列表里没有这些文件，ComfyUI 会报 Value not in list。请先下载模型，或在节点里改成你本机已有的模型名。

4. bypass_i2v is false by default. If it is true, the reference image branch is skipped and uploaded images will not affect output.

Animate the exact provided image as the first frame. Preserve the same young woman, face, hairstyle, white tank top, gray shorts, body proportions, and overall appearance. The scene is an outdoor school sports field / running track in soft daylight. The woman walks forward slowly and naturally on the track, with small stable steps, relaxed arms, subtle hair movement, and calm facial expression. Gentle camera push-in, smooth cinematic motion, stable full-body framing, realistic lighting, natural shadows, clean background, high quality video. Keep identity and outfit consistent. Do not redesign the character.
